description: This file defines an interface 'BankingService' in a banking application. It declares methods for managing customers, accounts, transactions, and transfers, serving as a contract for implementing banking operations.

classes.name: BankingService
classes.description: Interface defining banking-related operations such as customer management, account handling, and transaction processing.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all customers.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Adds a new customer with provided details.

methods.name: findByCustomerNumber
methods.description: Finds customer details using their customer number.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Updates existing customer information based on customer number.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a customer identified by customer number.

methods.name: findByAccountNumber
methods.description: Finds details associated with an account number.

methods.name: addNewAccount
methods.description: Creates a new account linked to a customer.

methods.name: transferDetails
methods.description: Processes a transfer of funds for a customer.

methods.name: findTransactionsByAccountNumber
methods.description: Retrieves transaction history for a specific account.
